text:
The plate looks like a square dinner plate of about 24 cm across. I'm treating it as a standard dinner plate for scale.

The red-orange grain dish on the right (tomato quinoa or bulgur with herbs) covers about 10 cm by 9 cm and is roughly 2.5 cm high. That comes to about 150 g.

The sliced chicken or tofu strips on the left cover about 8 cm by 6 cm and are thin. I estimate about 70 g.

The slaw (cabbage, carrot and onion) is about 50 g.

The plantain or potato pieces are partly hidden, so I estimate about 30 g.
